data.narrative:
Genesis AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $105M to date. The comparable universe in Robotics & Manufacturing comprises 9 private firms and 1 public company (277810.KQ), including peers such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Only one valuation method proved applicable to this analysis. Stage-Progression, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions, yields $262M based on the $105M total raised as a valuation proxy. This reflects the expected capital structure progression from current funding. Peer-Median comparison was not applicable; while 11 robotics and manufacturing companies exist in the broader comp set, none of the narrower filters—same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier—yielded the minimum three datapoints required for robust median calculation. A broader sector median would introduce excessive noise given the heterogeneity of robotics subsectors and stage distributions.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $223M (low) to $302M (high), centered at $262M. This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty. The absence of tight peer comparables limits confidence in the step-up assumption for Genesis AI's specific sector positioning. Stage and capital structure remain the primary anchors; revenue, profitability, and product-market validation metrics were not available to cross-check the implied valuation.
